goal: Is ke baad aap loop se array mein value search kar sakte hain, pehle match ki position ya 'not found' bata sakte hain, saari positions dhoondh sakte hain, aur comparisons ginn sakte hain.
warmup: Hostel ke store room mein 8 bags ke dher mein aap ka phone charger kho gaya hai. Aap bag 1 kholte hain, phir bag 2, phir bag 3, ek ke baad ek, aur jaise hi charger mil jaye ruk jate hain. Agar woh kisi bag mein nahi hai to yeh aap ko SAB bags kholne ke baad hi pata chalta hai. Yehi linear search hai: shuru se ek ek check karo, pehle match par ruk jao, aur 'not found' sirf aakhri bag ke baad kaho.
definition: Linear search (isay sequential search bhi kehte hain) array ke elements ko ek ek karke, index 0 se aage, check karta hai aur har ek ko us value se compare karta hai jo hamein chahiye (key ya target). Yeh har array par kaam karta hai, sorted ho ya na ho. Hum aam taur par ek variable pos rakhte hain jo -1 se shuru hota hai. Value -1 ka matlab hai 'abhi tak nahi mila', aur yeh mehfooz hai kyun ke -1 kabhi asli index nahi ho sakta.
howItWorks: Visual mein sweep dekhein. Loop variable i index 0, 1, 2 aur isi tarah par jata hai. Har box par woh ek sawal poochta hai: kya a[i] key ke barabar hai? Agar haan, to hum pos = i save kar lete hain aur break se search rok dete hain, kyun ke pehla match kaafi hai. Agar loop bina match ke khatam ho jaye to pos abhi bhi -1 hota hai, is liye hum 'not found' print karte hain. Tarteeb note karein: 'found ya not found' ka message loop ke BAAD print hona chahiye, loop ke andar nahi, kyun ke ek ghalat box ka matlab yeh nahi ke value maujood hi nahi. Har occurrence dhoondhne ke liye break use na karein: loop ko end tak chalne dein aur har match ko print ya count karein. Har box ke check ko comparison kehte hain. Best case: key pehle box mein hai, 1 comparison. Worst case: key aakhri box mein hai ya hai hi nahi, n comparisons. Yaani boxes jitne zyada hon, search utni der le sakta hai.
